snippet.title: Unstoppable (Say My Name) 💀⚡ | Dark Power Anthem | Echo Craft
snippet.description:
They tried to stop it.
They couldn't.

"Unstoppable" is the anthem for the force 
that cannot be contained — the power that 
rises when everything tries to hold it down. 
Dark. Heavy. Relentless.

This is not a warning.
This is a declaration.

🎧 Stream & Download:
Join the World of Echo Craft:
https://www.echocraftmusic.com

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
LYRICS:
[Intro - low distorted guitar, rumbling]
(Deep, gritty voice)
You hear that…?
That’s not thunder…
That’s me coming…

---

[Verse 1 - slow, heavy, menacing]
I was built from rage and stone  
No mercy carved into my bones  
Step aside or get erased  
I don’t slow, I don’t break pace  

They tried chains, they tried control  
Tried to dig inside my soul  
But the deeper that they went  
Made a monster heaven-sent  

---

[Pre-Chorus - rising tension]
You can run, you can hide  
But you can’t outrun what’s inside  

---

[Chorus - heavy, arrogant]
I don’t stop—I don’t bend  
I don’t break—I don’t end  
Step in my path, you won’t survive  
I am the force you can’t deny  

Unstoppable—say my name  
Worlds collide when I bring pain  
You can pray, you can shout  
Ain’t nobody taking me out  

---

[Verse 2 - more aggressive]
Mind of fire, fists like steel  
Every step—you know it’s real  
Ground shake when I arrive  
You don’t fight—you just survive  

Call me curse, call me king  
I don’t care what title you bring  
From the shadows to the throne  
I take everything I own  

---

[Pre-Chorus - stronger]
You can stand, you can try  
But you won’t be the reason I die  

---

[Chorus - louder, more chaotic]
I don’t stop—I don’t bend  
I don’t break—I don’t end  
Step in my path, you won’t survive  
I am the force you can’t deny  

Unstoppable—say my name  
Worlds collide when I bring pain  
You can pray, you can shout  
Ain’t nobody taking me out  

---

[Bridge - dark, mystical, slowed]
(Whispered, eerie)

Something ancient in my veins…  
Something calling out my name…  

(Heavy build)

Not a man… not a god…  
I’m the wrath you can’t outrun…  

(SCREAM)
TRY TO STOP ME!!!  

---

[Breakdown - crushing, slow]
(Stomp rhythm)

Step… by step…  
You feel the end…  

Step… by step…  
Say your prayers…  

---

[Final Chorus - full power]
I don’t stop—I don’t bend  
I don’t break—I don’t end  
Step in my path, you won’t survive  
I am the force you can’t deny  

Unstoppable—feel my weight  
Every second seals your fate  
You can scream, you can doubt  
Still nobody taking me out  

---

[Outro - fading, ominous]
(Deep, calm)

I was never meant to fall…
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

snippet.title: Crown Pon Mi Head 👑 | Reggae Anthem for the Loyal Queen | Echo Craft
snippet.description:
Here's the updated description with the lyrics added in a natural spot — after the intro copy and before the streaming link:

👑 She never begged for love. She chose it.
Crown Pon Me Head is a conscious reggae anthem for the woman who knows her worth — the queen whose crown never tilts, never slides, because her foundation is built on loyalty, faith, and real love. This isn't about perfection. It's about depth over shine. About standing beside your king not because you have to — but because you choose to. Every single day.
For every woman who loves without losing herself. 👑🌺

🎵 LYRICS
[INTRO]
(bass groove begins)
(organ skank enters softly)
(ad-lib softly)
Mmmm… yeah…
Queen never beg fi love…
She choose it.
👑 [CHORUS]
Crown pon mi head, it nah tilt, nah slide
Shine so bright 'cause mi treat mi king right
Loyalty firm, mi nah hide, nah hide
Even when him eyes not pon mi side
Crown pon mi head, sit proper, sit tall
Jah bless di union, foundation strong wall
Mi no captive, mi no chained at all
Mi choose fi stand beside him through it all
(harmony repeat)
Crown pon mi head…
🌺 [VERSE 1 – Why Her Crown Shines]
Mi crown no crooked, it balance clean
Because mi heart pure, mi love serene
When mi king step out inna di world so wide
Him know seh mi stand pon him side
No other queen cyaan match mi touch
No other mind study him so much
Mi know him silence, mi know him sigh
Mi see di storm before it reach him eye
Beauty deh everywhere pon display
Different glow inna different way
But di beauty him see when him look pon me
Is deeper than di eye can see
(ad-lib softly)
Depth over shine…
👑 [CHORUS]
Crown pon mi head, it nah tilt, nah slide
Shine so bright 'cause mi treat mi king right
Loyalty firm, mi nah hide, nah hide
Even when him eyes not pon mi side
Crown pon mi head, sit proper, sit tall
Jah bless di union, foundation strong wall
Mi no captive, mi no chained at all
Mi choose fi stand beside him through it all
🌊 [VERSE 2 – Outside Temptations]
Other kings try fi test di throne
Rude advance pon di telephone
Sweet talk try fi bend mi ear
But mi nah move, mi vision clear
Dem see di shine and waan compete
But mi kingdom already complete
Mi nah sway by fleeting glance
Mi loyalty nuh circumstance
Mi know mi Maker, mi know mi Jah
Him bless mi life, him set di law
Di ruler of mi destiny
Place mi king right next to me
(ad-lib firm)
Set in stone.
🌅 [BRIDGE – Mutual Submission / Foundation]
(drums soften slightly, bass steady)
Mi no submit because mi weak
Mi strong enough fi kneel and speak
Him submit back, respect complete
Two hearts steady, one heartbeat
Trust no need fi constant proof
We build pon truth beneath di roof
Love like dis nuh need surveillance
Foundation laid inna silence
(harmony)
Steadfast… steady… sure…
👑 [FINAL CHORUS – FULL HARMONIES]
Crown pon mi head, it nah tilt, nah slide
Shine so bright 'cause mi treat mi king right
Loyalty firm, mi nah hide, nah hide
Even when him eyes not pon mi side
Crown pon mi head, sit proper, sit tall
Jah bless di union, foundation strong wall
Mi no captive, mi no chained at all
Mi choose fi stand beside him through it all
(ad-lib softly)
Mi king… mi king…
🌴 [OUTRO]
(bass and organ ride out)
Queen know who she is…
And who she belong to.
(ad-lib)
Crown steady.
(music fades)

snippet.title: The Girl with the Black Curly Hair | Echo Craft | Latin Pop | 4K 60fps
snippet.description:
"¿Quién es ella?" — nobody knows… 👁️

She walked in and the whole room froze. Curly black hair like a midnight glow. And just like that… she was gone.

The Girl with the Black Curly Hair by Echo Craft — a bilingual Latin Pop story about the one who got away before you even knew her name.

🎬 4K 60fps

Stream everywhere 👇
🌐 echocraftmusic.com

LYRICS:

[Intro]
Yeah…
Who is she…?

[Verse 1]
Saw her walking through the room so slow
Curly black hair like a midnight glow
Every step got the whole place froze
But nobody here seems to know
Eyes on her but she don't look back
Like she move in her own soundtrack
I ask around, they just shrug like that
Like she came and just faded to black

[Pre-Chorus]
I said "¿Quién es ella?" no one say nada
Everybody watching but nobody got her

[Chorus]
What's her name…?
That girl with the black curly hair
¿Dónde va? I don't know, I just stare
Something 'bout the way she moves through the air
What's her name…?
Got me caught in a moment right there
¿Quién será? I swear it ain't fair
Nobody knows that girl with the black curly hair

[Verse 2]
Now she dancing where the lights fall low
Moving like a rhythm I don't even know
Heartbeat syncing with the tempo
Tryna play it cool but I can't let go
Walk past me, I freeze in place
Little smile but I miss her face
Turn around, she gone without a trace
Like a dream I can't replace

[Pre-Chorus]
"¿Quién es ella?" still no answer
Like she vanish in the night like magic

[Chorus]
What's her name…?
That girl with the black curly hair
¿Dónde va? I don't know, I just stare
Something 'bout the way she moves through the air
What's her name…?
Got me caught in a moment right there
¿Quién será? I swear it ain't fair
Nobody knows that girl with the black curly hair

[Bridge]
I don't need forever… just one night
Just one word… just one sign

[Final Verse]
I step closer, now she right there
Same eyes, same black curly hair
Say "hola"… she just smiles slow
Like she already knows
I say "tell me, what's your name?"
She just laughs and walks away…

[Final Chorus]
What's her name…?
That girl with the black curly hair
¿Dónde va? I don't know, I just stare
Now she gone but I still feel her there
What's her name…?
Left me lost in the midnight air
¿Quién será? I swear it ain't fair
Still don't know that girl with the black curly hair

[Outro]
¿Quién es ella…?

#EchoCraft #TheGirlWithTheBlackCurlyHair #LatinPop #NewMusic #BilingualMusic #LatinVibes #NewMusicFriday #LatinMusic #NewSingle #MusicRelease

each other — really see each other — and choose to

Lyrics :

INTRO (Soft percussion + guitar + pads)

(Hums, gentle “mmm-mm” ad-libs from her)

VERSE 1 – HER (Warm, admiring, safe love)

You don’t rush me, you don’t cross my line
Every move you make feels so divine
Strong like stone but your touch is kind
You read my heart like it’s written in time

When the world gets loud, you quiet my mind
Your arms my shelter, my favorite sign
I choose you daily, not by design
But by the peace I feel inside

You’re my safe space, my steady ground
When I’m with you, I’m never lost or found

PRE-CHORUS – HER

Slow it down, don’t waste the taste
Good love grows when we take our space

HOOK / CHORUS – BOTH (Soft harmony, catchy)

Tasty, tasty — love so sweet
Just a little taste, don’t rush the treat
Not hasty, hasty — move so slow
Every bite of love I wanna know

Tasty, tasty — you and me
Savor every moment patiently
We don’t rush what’s meant to be
That’s why our love tastes heavenly

VERSE 2 – HIM (Confident, respectful, poetic)

When I first laid eyes on you, I froze in place
Had to catch my breath, admire your grace
I don’t wanna swear or disrespect your name

snippet.title: A Light Through Darkness | Light's intervention | Echo Craft
snippet.description:
This one is unapologetic.

Jesus Christ is the Light through darkness.
Through chaos. Through doubt. Through pressure. Through the weight of everyday life.

This song is a hard metal declaration of that truth.

When everything feels heavy, when the noise gets loud, when the world feels unstable — His light doesn’t flicker.

It burns steady.

“A Light Through Darkness” is for the metalheads who love Jesus.
For those who worship loud.
For those who fight battles with faith.
For those who know that strength isn’t weakness — it’s surrender to something greater.

If you’ve ever needed a reminder that you’re not walking alone, this is your anthem.

🔥 Step into the fire. Let the Light break through.

Echo Craft creates emotion-driven music across genres and cultures — from metal to reggaeton to soul — built around conviction, energy, and movement.

The tools help shape the sound.
The belief fuels the fire.
